content.text:
I added keyboard entry and a SCI key that opens a small panel with √x, x² and 1/x. Each acts on the current entry at once, so `9 √` shows 3. √ of a negative number and 1/0 show Error, and the history reads √9, 9², 1/9. Clicks and keys go through the same code, so in the error state only Escape works. I ran 31 checks in headless Chrome: the new features and all earlier ones (sums, left-to-right order, rounding, divide by zero, ±, brackets, history, memory). All passed, so nothing needed fixing.

I rejected treating √ of a negative as anything other than Error, and letting Enter also press a focused button. To fit SCI, M+ is no longer a double-width key.
